results.rationale: Consistency: controller silhouette, blue color and button arrangement remain, with slight loss/change of touchpad surface detail. Instruction: blue gradient, soft shadow and upper-central controller are present, but text reads 'Prest Start', uses heavy serif-like lettering and lacks the requested period; it is also oversized for the restrained layout. Quality: coherent controller, but malformed wording and overlapping headline lines are clear typography flaws.

Consistency: pavement and background remain, but the intact deck section changes its angle and contour. Instruction: the broken end is not restored to a complete smooth deck; extra wheels and a truck are instead placed on top of the damaged nose. Quality: a severely incoherent skateboard has wheels both above and below the deck, disconnected support geometry and a still-frayed front.
